title: Mapping Images to Narrative
description: VALESKA needs visual material to retain its place in the work, not merely a location on a drive. I am extending the collector with episode, scene, and beat fields while adding curated and working sources.
body:
2026-02-11. VALESKA needs visual material to retain its place in the work, not merely a location on a drive. I am extending the collector with episode, scene, and beat fields while adding curated and working sources.

What this establishes

The work remains a bounded technical experiment. It creates evidence for the next decision without claiming a finished understanding of the collection.

Historical basis: This entry is dated to the 2026-02-11 repository milestone, commit 2549be7. It is based on the contemporaneous implementation record and its documented scope.
